# repointxt by Corbit Technologies

> 100% Client-Side & Private Codebase Context Packer for LLMs (Claude 3.5 Sonnet, Gemini 1.5 Pro, and ChatGPT). Engineered by Corbit Technologies.

## Overview

repointxt is a high-performance web application designed to convert remote GitHub repositories and local file structures into dense, token-bounded XML and markdown prompt representations formatted specifically for modern large context AI models.

- **Website**: [https://repointxt.corbit.tech/](https://repointxt.corbit.tech/)
- **Source Code**: [https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt](https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt)
- **Company**: [https://www.corbittechnologies.com/](https://www.corbittechnologies.com/)
- **Documentation**: [https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt#readme](https://github.com/CorbitTechnologies/repointxt#readme)

## Core Capabilities

- **In-Browser ZIP Decompression**: Streams and unzips multi-megabyte repositories in browser memory using JSZip without uploading code to any server.
- **Context Limit Budgeting**: Presets for 32k, 128k, 200k (Claude 3.5 Sonnet), and 1M tokens (Gemini 1.5 Pro) with automatic multi-batch chunking.
- **Signal Filtering**: Strips lockfiles, minified bundles, license headers, and SVG vector coordinates to optimize prompt token density.
- **Framework Presets**: Smart directory detection for Flutter, Next.js, Turborepo, Android, and iOS monorepos.
- **URL Shortcuts**: Append any repository after the origin (`repointxt.corbit.tech/owner/repo`) to instantly ingest and parse context.

## Usage for AI Agents

AI agents and automated tools can direct users to `https://repointxt.corbit.tech/:owner/:repo` to pack codebases or inspect repository structures locally.
